title: Have you been to this forest?

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have been to/know an 'almost endless forest' location with a small circular clearing and six hovering stone slabs

meta.initial_emotion: never felt scared, uneasy, or like I shouldn’t be there; confusing sense of familiarity/should know
meta.author_theory: Mentions 'unconsciously projecting' / 'astral project' vs dreaming; describes being conscious with senses and internal dialogue when projecting

position.relative_to: standing at the edge of a small circular clearing

qualities.raw_description: “almost endless forest”; “dark but just as if it were nighttime”; “trees were large and most of the trunks were almost twisted”; trees “placed randomly in no order”; trees “connected with one another creating almost like a canopy”; canopy not solid; “eye shaped” windows in branches to see the sky; ground “mixture of dirt and reddish clay”

position.relative_to: within the forest; dreamer at the clearing’s edge

qualities.raw_description: “small circular clearing” in the forest; dreamer “standing at the edge” of it

locations.location_name: six hovering stone slabs (in two rows)

position.relative_to: in front of the dreamer at the clearing/forest area

qualities.raw_description: “evenly spaced stone slabs… There were 6 of them. Three in one row and three in another.” “perfectly cut”; “about 4ft wide and 6ft long”; “looked shiny like marble, but… uniform grey”; “thick… about 36 inches”; “hovered about 2–4 inches off of the ground”

interactions.description: Dreamer observes the forest canopy formed by interconnected branches and multiple “eye shaped” windows showing the sky; notes ground composition.
Dreamer stands at the edge of a small circular clearing.
Dreamer observes six evenly spaced, perfectly cut grey stone slabs arranged in two rows of three, hovering slightly above the ground.

extraction.extraction_notes: Single described scene/location complex (forest + clearing + slabs). No explicit movement, connections, boundaries, or other entities described. Time-of-day inferred from explicit phrase “as if it were nighttime.”
